project_info.name: SOLD AI Studio
project_info.tagline: AI-First Branding & Digital Design Studio in Singapore
project_info.reference_style: Puture (puture.co.kr/en) - Neo-grotesk dark tech aesthetic, electric blue light beam, floating 3D tiles, perspective crosshair grid, chapter indicators, text highlight blocks, pinned terminal process.

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-white leading-tight
hierarchy.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-white

rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings; use light-weight Helvetica/Sans display (font-light text-4xl to text-6xl) with tight tracking.
Use JetBrains Mono or SFMono for tags, chapter tags [01][STUDIO], process terminal lines (> concept — ...), and project metrics.
Highlight key narrative words in the Manifesto section using solid electric blue inline rectangle background boxes with white text.

visual_enhancers.hero_canvas: Perspective 3D grid plane with '+' crosshair intersection markers, floating starfield dust, and right-aligned radial electric blue beam glow (#2D6BFF to transparent).
visual_enhancers.floating_3d_tiles: CSS/Framer-motion powered 3D floating glossy rounded dark blue glass tiles with white line icons that orbit or gently hover around headline text.
visual_enhancers.chapter_indicator: Fixed bottom-left indicator '01 CHAPTER ABOUT' / '02 CHAPTER SERVICES' updating dynamically on scroll.
visual_enhancers.mono_badge_chips: Double mini box chips like [01][ABOUT] (blue mini box + white text box).
visual_enhancers.service_cards: Light background white cards in dark theme sections containing light-blue grid illustration vector panels, blue icon tile, mono numbered '01', mono tag chips, and 'Learn more →' footer row.
visual_enhancers.process_pinned_step: Pinned 3-step timeline with terminal-style code text '> concept — visual engineering' and animated progress percentage '10% -> 50% -> 100%'.

layout_and_grids.spacing_scale: p-6 to p-12 for containers, py-20 to py-32 for sections
layout_and_grids.hero_grid: Grid 12-column layout: 8 cols for kinetic headline & sub copy, 4 cols for key actions and project callouts.
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: Asymmetric 3-column & 4-column bento layouts for Works and Services showcase with subgrid support.
layout_and_grids.nav_bar: Fixed top bar with backdrop blur (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10), top right links with plus indicators (About+, Works+, Process+, Studio+), KO/EN language toggle, and blue 'Start a project' CTA button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or smooth framer-motion scroll handlers for high fidelity motion pacing.
Set dark theme (#03060F background) globally in index.css and main wrapper with electric blue glows.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, form filters, chapter indicators) have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Form submission on /contact must save enquiries locally and call API endpoints with simulated success feedback toast using sonner.
Make full responsive layout with mobile drawer navigation, responsive text clamp sizes (ceiling max 6xl), and responsive grid columns.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain gradients; construct perspective grids, radial glows, and micro-animations.
Avoid default Inter for headings. Use Helvetica / Sans display light weight for main titles.
Always include visible Navigation bar with top-right actions and bottom-left dynamic chapter indicator.
Ensure hover states explicitly specify text color to prevent invisible dark text on dark backgrounds.
All forms must use customized Shadcn/UI inputs, selects, sliders, and checkboxes with validation.
